fusions.name: Petrifying Stare
fusions.desc: Fixes your gaze on an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stony Regard
fusions.desc: You sweep your gaze across a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage and stunning everything in it for 1.2 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave each one [Leaden], its Speed drained, for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorgon's Hold
fusions.desc: You widen your eyes for 1 second, then every creature within 5 tiles is held in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Seen Seams
fusions.desc: Your earth damage cannot be resisted.
